description: Malawi - Energy Access Survey Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Surveys", published or maintained by Elisa Portale (World Bank Group). "This database has been collected by ESMAP as validation exercise for the multi-tier energy access questionnaire in Malawi. The multi-tier definition and measurement of energy access is an approach that goes beyond the traditional binary measures of access. Coverage: Malawi. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy access, Surveys. The portal gives 2010 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
